text:
maria: quick check — seeing sporadic 2x tail latency on small-chat on A100L when seq=1024. can someone capture a short nsys run (60s) + torch.prof so we can correlate timeline <> python stacks? trying to repro before i open a regression PR.

aj: can do. prefer single-run full-timeline or a few short snapshots? which machine?

maria: single 60s timeline should surface the spike. A100L-2 if available. please enable nvtx spans around inference and kv cache ops.

aj: copying command i’ll run, lmk if you want different flags. will annotate NVTX spans `inference:start` / `inference:end` / `kv:fetch` in the code.
```
nsys profile --output /tmp/nsys_maria_1887654321 --trace=cuda,nvtx,cpu --duration=60 --sample=cpu --force-overwrite \
  --capture-range=none --capture-limit=0 --gpu-metrics-device=0 \
  python -m run_infer --model small-chat --batch 8 --seq 1024
```

Torch profiler (short):
```
with torch.profiler.profile(activities=[CPU, CUDA], record_shapes=False, with_stack=False) as p:
    run_inference()
    p.export_chrome_trace('/tmp/torch_prof_maria_1887654321.json')
```

maria: perfect — also export the `.qdrep` for nsight and the flamegraph svg if the perf script generates one. drop into gs://redwood-perf/maria/1887654321/ and paste link here.

aj: starting capture on A100L-2 now (10:15 PT). will add env var DEBUG_KVCACHE=1 to get kv logs and NVTX spans. ETA ~10:25.

perf-bot: upload started -> gs://redwood-perf/maria/1887654321/nsys_maria_1887654321.qdrep

aj: upload complete: https://storage.googleapis.com/redwood-perf/maria/1887654321/nsys_maria_1887654321.qdrep (2.3GB), torch profile: https://storage.googleapis.com/redwood-perf/maria/1887654321/torch_prof_maria_1887654321.json, flamegraph: https://storage.googleapis.com/redwood-perf/maria/1887654321/flame_maria_1887654321.svg :thumbsup:

kevin: quick skim — nsight shows a big kernel stall ~1.2s into the interval on SM30 CUBLAS_Teardown. seems correlated with a KV cache fetch remote miss (see NVTX span). can you rerun one short capture with env KVCACHE_PREFETCH=0 to force synchronous fetch?

maria: good find, kevin. yes do a second run with prefetch off and also capture pprof from the service (pprof port 6060) so we can get Go/runtime stacks.

luca: if you want a tighter timeline, set nsys `--trace=cuda,nvtx --sample=cpu --sample-interval=500us` and a 30s run focused on the spike window — smaller file to analyze.

aj: noted. i'll run a 30s focused capture with prefetch disabled and pprof. backing up current artifacts to gs://redwood-perf/maria/1887654321/archive/ then re-run.

sophie: if this is deterministic, i can kick off a mini-bisect across model versions (v1.3->v1.6) with the same capture harness. will need an automated runner that uploads to the same bucket and tags results.

maria: please do, sophie — if bisect shows regressions we can pin older model on Dedicated until we fix. also please include model git sha and runtime package versions in a README next to each capture.

aj: second run started with `KVCACHE_PREFETCH=0`, pprof enabled and NVTX annotation. short command: `pprof &; env KVCACHE_PREFETCH=0 nsys profile --output /tmp/nsys_maria_1887654321_run2 --trace=cuda,nvtx --duration=30 python -m run_infer ...`

perf-bot: upload complete -> https://storage.googleapis.com/redwood-perf/maria/1887654321/nsys_maria_1887654321_run2.qdrep (1.1GB)

kevin: second trace shows the missed prefetch causes a synchronous stall at the same spot — confirms kv miss hypothesis. i've attached a tiny snip in the notes (see flame svg). next step: determine whether prefetch scheduling changed in the runtime between v1.4 and v1.5.

maria: awesome, thanks everyone. aj — can you tag the two qdreps with `kv-miss-confirmed` and paste the exact nvprof/cuda kernel names you saw? i'll file a regression issue with links and a small reproduce checklist.

aj: done — tagged and added kernel names in the bucket README. nvcc kernel: `cublasLtMatmul` + `cudaMemcpyPeerAsync` stall observed. filing artifacts under path and pinging infra if we need host-side NIC traces.

maria: filing issue now and will include steps to repro + pprof + links. assigning to @kevin and @sophie for follow-ups. closing thread here once issue is up. :white_check_mark:
